name: Question 5
worked_solution:
We will use the following identity:

$$
∇\cdot (f\,F)=f\,∇\cdot F+F\cdot ∇f
$$

First, we compute $∇\cdot F$ and $∇f.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f & =⟨2xz,0,{x}^{2}⟩, \\ ∇\cdot F & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(\operatorname{ln}⁡x)+\frac{∂}{∂y}(x{z}^{3})+\frac{∂}{∂z}({z}^{2})=\frac{1}{x}+2z.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\cdot (f\,F) & =f\,∇\cdot F+F\cdot ∇f \\  & ={x}^{2}z(\frac{1}{x}+2z)+⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡x,x{z}^{3},{z}^{2}⟩\cdot ⟨2xz,0,{x}^{2}⟩ \\  & =xz+2{x}^{2}{z}^{2}+2xz\operatorname{ln}⁡x+{x}^{2}{z}^{2} \\  & =xz+3{x}^{2}{z}^{2}+2xz\operatorname{ln}⁡x \\  & =xz(1+3xz+2\operatorname{ln}⁡x).\end{aligned}
$$

Question 5
?

Given that F(x,y,z)=⟨ln⁡x,xz3,z2⟩ and f(x,y,z)=x2z, calculate ∇⋅(fF).

a
xz(1+3xz+2ln⁡x)
b
xz(1+3yxz+2yln⁡x)
c
xz(1+xz+ln⁡x)
d
xz(1+3x2z2+2xzln⁡x)
e
xz(3xz+ln⁡x)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We will use the following identity:

∇⋅(fF)=f∇⋅F+F⋅∇f

First, we compute ∇⋅F and ∇f. We get

∇f=⟨2xz,0,x2⟩,∇⋅F=∂∂x(ln⁡x)+∂∂y(xz3)+∂∂z(z2)=1x+2z.

Therefore, we have ∇⋅(fF)=f∇⋅F+F⋅∇f=x2z(1x+2z)+⟨ln⁡x,xz3,z2⟩⋅⟨2xz,0,x2⟩=xz+2x2z2+2xzln⁡x+x2z2=xz+3x2z2+2xzln⁡x=xz(1+3xz+2ln⁡x).
